---
title: "Explore Mediation Screening Results"
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(data.table)
    library(here)
    library(qs2)
})
here::i_am(".git/HEAD")

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) < 1 || all(is.na(x))) y else x

code_med_dir <- here("code", "22_Mediation")
out_data_dir <- here("processed-data", "22_Mediation")
dir.create(out_data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

main_designs <- data.table::data.table(
    source_dir = c("out-erc_astro", "out-lc_astro", "out-lc_nm", "out-lc_nm_int"),
    design = c("green", "blue", "orange", "orange"),
    model = c("ERC_Astro", "LC_ERC", "NM_bin", "NM_int")
)

read_run_signature <- function(path) {
    if (!file.exists(path)) return(list())
    lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
    lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
    if (length(lines) < 1L) return(list())
    kv <- strsplit(lines, "=", fixed = TRUE)
    keys <- trimws(vapply(kv, function(x) x[1], character(1)))
    vals <- trimws(vapply(kv, function(x) paste(x[-1], collapse = "="), character(1)))
    out <- as.list(vals)
    names(out) <- keys
    out
}

as_num <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || length(x) < 1) return(NA_real_)
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trimws(as.character(x[[1]]))))
}

as_int <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || length(x) < 1) return(NA_integer_)
    suppressWarnings(as.integer(trimws(as.character(x[[1]]))))
}

parse_mediator_file <- function(lst_file) {
    stem <- sub("\\.mediated\\.lst$", "", basename(lst_file))
    parts <- strsplit(stem, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(parts) < 3L) {
        stop("Could not parse mediator list filename: ", basename(lst_file))
    }
    cluster <- parts[1]
    med_gene_id <- parts[2]
    mediator_gene <- paste(parts[3:length(parts)], collapse = "_")
    list(
        cluster = cluster,
        med_gene_id = med_gene_id,
        mediator_gene = mediator_gene,
        mediator_ref = sprintf("%s:%s", cluster, mediator_gene),
        mediation_run = sprintf("%s|%s|%s", cluster, med_gene_id, mediator_gene)
    )
}

read_mediated_genes <- function(lst_file) {
    lines <- trimws(readLines(lst_file, warn = FALSE))
    lines <- lines[nzchar(lines)]
    if (length(lines) < 1L) return(character(0))
    parts <- strsplit(lines, "|", fixed = TRUE)
    genes <- vapply(parts, function(x) {
        if (length(x) >= 2L && nzchar(trimws(x[2]))) {
            trimws(x[2])
        } else if (length(x) >= 1L) {
            trimws(x[1])
        } else {
            ""
        }
    }, character(1))
    genes <- genes[nzchar(genes)]
    genes[!duplicated(genes)]
}

resolve_latest_complete_run <- function(out_dir) {
    run_history_path <- file.path(out_dir, "run_history.tsv")
    if (!file.exists(run_history_path)) {
        stop("Missing run_history.tsv in ", out_dir)
    }
    rh <- data.table::fread(run_history_path)
    if (!("run_hash" %in% names(rh)) || nrow(rh) < 1L) {
        stop("run_history.tsv missing run_hash or has no rows in ", out_dir)
    }

    rh <- data.table::copy(rh)
    rh[, run_finished_at_posix := as.POSIXct(sub(" UTC$", "", as.character(run_finished_at)), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")]
    rh[, row_id := .I]
    data.table::setorderv(rh, c("run_finished_at_posix", "row_id"), order = c(-1L, -1L), na.last = TRUE)

    missing_map <- list()
    req_for_hash <- function(h) {
        list(
            fn_sig = file.path(out_dir, sprintf("run_signature_%s.txt", h)),
            fn_md = file.path(out_dir, sprintf("med_degs_%s.qs2", h)),
            fn_dge = file.path(out_dir, sprintf("dge_base_%s.qs2", h)),
            fn_mi = file.path(out_dir, sprintf("mediation_run_index.%s.tsv", h)),
            fn_sm = file.path(out_dir, sprintf("mediation_vs_baseline_summary.%s.tsv.gz", h)),
            fn_bi = file.path(out_dir, sprintf("baseline_index.%s.tsv", h))
        )
    }

    selected <- NULL
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rh))) {
        h <- as.character(rh$run_hash[i])
        p <- req_for_hash(h)
        exists_vec <- vapply(p, file.exists, logical(1))
        if (all(exists_vec)) {
            selected <- list(
                run_hash = h,
                history_row = rh[i],
                run_history = rh,
                paths = p,
                selection_mode = "latest_complete_hash",
                selection_warning = "",
                used_fallback = FALSE,
                latest_complete_run_hash = h
            )
            break
        }
        missing_map[[h]] <- names(exists_vec)[!exists_vec]
    }

    if (!is.null(selected)) {
        return(selected)
    }

    latest <- rh[1]
    h <- as.character(latest$run_hash[[1]])
    p_fallback <- list(
        fn_sig = if (file.exists(file.path(out_dir, sprintf("run_signature_%s.txt", h)))) file.path(out_dir, sprintf("run_signature_%s.txt", h)) else file.path(out_dir, "run_signature_latest.txt"),
        fn_md = if (file.exists(file.path(out_dir, sprintf("med_degs_%s.qs2", h)))) file.path(out_dir, sprintf("med_degs_%s.qs2", h)) else file.path(out_dir, "med_degs.qs2"),
        fn_dge = if (file.exists(file.path(out_dir, sprintf("dge_base_%s.qs2", h)))) file.path(out_dir, sprintf("dge_base_%s.qs2", h)) else file.path(out_dir, "dge_base.qs2"),
        fn_mi = if (file.exists(file.path(out_dir, sprintf("mediation_run_index.%s.tsv", h)))) file.path(out_dir, sprintf("mediation_run_index.%s.tsv", h)) else file.path(out_dir, "mediation_run_index.tsv"),
        fn_sm = if (file.exists(file.path(out_dir, sprintf("mediation_vs_baseline_summary.%s.tsv.gz", h)))) file.path(out_dir, sprintf("mediation_vs_baseline_summary.%s.tsv.gz", h)) else file.path(out_dir, "mediation_vs_baseline_summary.tsv.gz"),
        fn_bi = if (file.exists(file.path(out_dir, sprintf("baseline_index.%s.tsv", h)))) file.path(out_dir, sprintf("baseline_index.%s.tsv", h)) else file.path(out_dir, "baseline_index.tsv")
    )
    missing_after_fallback <- names(vapply(p_fallback, file.exists, logical(1)))[!vapply(p_fallback, file.exists, logical(1))]
    if (length(missing_after_fallback) > 0L) {
        stop("Could not resolve required run artifacts in ", out_dir, "; missing: ", paste(missing_after_fallback, collapse = ", "))
    }

    list(
        run_hash = h,
        history_row = latest,
        run_history = rh,
        paths = p_fallback,
        selection_mode = "fallback_unqualified",
        selection_warning = sprintf("No complete hash-pinned run found; used fallback artifacts for hash %s", h),
        used_fallback = TRUE,
        latest_complete_run_hash = NA_character_
    )
}

assert_single_run_hash <- function(dt, col, expected, label) {
    if (!(col %in% names(dt))) return(invisible(FALSE))
    vals <- unique(as.character(dt[[col]]))
    vals <- vals[!is.na(vals) & nzchar(vals)]
    if (length(vals) != 1L) {
        stop(sprintf("%s must contain exactly one non-empty %s value; found: %s", label, col, paste(vals, collapse = ",")))
    }
    if (!identical(vals[[1]], expected)) {
        stop(sprintf("%s %s mismatch: found %s but expected %s", label, col, vals[[1]], expected))
    }
    invisible(TRUE)
}

build_mediated_diag <- function(out_dir, valid_run_labels = character(0), small_first = TRUE) {
    if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
        stop("Mediation output directory not found: ", out_dir)
    }
    mediated_files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.mediated\\.lst$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(mediated_files) > 0L) {
        finfo <- file.info(mediated_files)
        mediated_files <- mediated_files[!is.na(finfo$size) & finfo$size > 0]
    }
    mediated_files <- sort(mediated_files)

    if (length(mediated_files) < 1L) {
        empty <- data.table::data.table(
            list_file = character(0),
            mediation_run = character(0),
            cluster = character(0),
            med_gene_id = character(0),
            mediator_gene = character(0),
            mediator_ref = character(0),
            n_mediated = integer(0),
            outcomes_preview = character(0),
            is_current_run = logical(0),
            list_path = character(0)
        )
        empty[, outcome_genes := vector("list", 0L)]
        return(list(
            all = empty,
            used = empty,
            stats = list(total = 0L, used = 0L, excluded_stale = 0L)
        ))
    }

    diag_rows <- lapply(mediated_files, function(f) {
        minfo <- parse_mediator_file(f)
        outcome_genes <- read_mediated_genes(f)
        run_lb <- as.character(minfo$mediation_run)
        data.table::data.table(
            list_file = basename(f),
            mediation_run = run_lb,
            cluster = minfo$cluster,
            med_gene_id = minfo$med_gene_id,
            mediator_gene = minfo$mediator_gene,
            mediator_ref = minfo$mediator_ref,
            n_mediated = length(outcome_genes),
            outcomes_preview = paste(head(outcome_genes, 6), collapse = ", "),
            is_current_run = run_lb %in% valid_run_labels,
            list_path = normalizePath(f, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE),
            outcome_genes = list(outcome_genes)
        )
    })
    diag_all <- data.table::rbindlist(diag_rows, fill = TRUE)
    diag_used <- diag_all[is_current_run == TRUE]

    ord <- if (isTRUE(small_first)) 1L else -1L
    if (nrow(diag_all) > 0L) data.table::setorderv(diag_all, c("n_mediated", "mediator_gene"), order = c(ord, 1L))
    if (nrow(diag_used) > 0L) data.table::setorderv(diag_used, c("n_mediated", "mediator_gene"), order = c(ord, 1L))

    list(
        all = diag_all,
        used = diag_used,
        stats = list(
            total = as.integer(nrow(diag_all)),
            used = as.integer(nrow(diag_used)),
            excluded_stale = as.integer(nrow(diag_all) - nrow(diag_used))
        )
    )
}

loadMedDataSummary <- function(out_dir) {
    resolved <- resolve_latest_complete_run(out_dir)
    pth <- c(list(
        out = out_dir,
        base_dir = file.path(out_dir, "baseline"),
        run_hash = resolved$run_hash,
        run_history = file.path(out_dir, "run_history.tsv")
    ), resolved$paths)

    md <- data.table::as.data.table(qs_read(pth$fn_md))
    dge <- qs_read(pth$fn_dge)
    mi <- data.table::fread(pth$fn_mi)
    sm <- data.table::fread(pth$fn_sm)
    bi <- if (file.exists(pth$fn_bi)) data.table::fread(pth$fn_bi) else NULL
    sig <- read_run_signature(pth$fn_sig)

    assert_single_run_hash(mi, "run_hash", pth$run_hash, "mediation_run_index")
    assert_single_run_hash(sm, "run_hash", pth$run_hash, "mediation_vs_baseline_summary")

    bf <- NULL
    if (!is.null(bi) && nrow(bi) > 0L && "out_file" %in% names(bi)) {
        bi2 <- data.table::copy(bi)
        if ("n_donors" %in% names(bi2)) {
            data.table::setorderv(bi2, cols = "n_donors", order = -1L)
        }
        bf <- bi2$out_file[1]
    } else {
        bf <- list.files(pth$base_dir, pattern = "^baseline_[0-9a-f]+\\.tab\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)[1]
    }
    if (is.na(bf) || !nzchar(bf) || !file.exists(bf)) {
        stop("Could not resolve baseline file in: ", pth$base_dir)
    }
    br <- data.table::fread(bf)

    if (is.null(dge$genes) || !("gene_name" %in% colnames(dge$genes))) {
        stop("dge_base$genes must contain gene_name in: ", out_dir)
    }
    gmap <- data.table::data.table(
        gene_name = as.character(dge$genes$gene_name),
        gene_id = rownames(dge$genes)
    )

    list(
        pth = pth,
        dt = list(md = md, mi = mi, sm = sm, bi = bi, br = br),
        meta = list(
            signature = sig,
            history_row = resolved$history_row,
            selection_mode = resolved$selection_mode,
            selection_warning = resolved$selection_warning,
            used_fallback = resolved$used_fallback,
            latest_complete_run_hash = resolved$latest_complete_run_hash
        ),
        key = list(gmap = gmap)
    )
}

resolve_mediator_row <- function(mg, md) {
    mg_cl <- NULL
    mg_nm <- mg
    if (grepl(":", mg, fixed = TRUE)) {
        pr <- strsplit(mg, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
        mg_cl <- pr[1]
        mg_nm <- pr[2]
    }
    rs <- md[gene_name == mg_nm | gene_id == mg_nm | med_gene_id == mg_nm]
    if (!is.null(mg_cl)) rs <- rs[cluster == mg_cl]
    if (nrow(rs) == 0L) stop("Mediator not found: ", mg)
    rs[nrow(rs)]
}

resolve_mediator_results_file <- function(pd, dt_mi, it, mgid, file_label, coef = c("carrier", "med_vec")) {
    coef <- match.arg(coef)
    file_col <- if (coef == "med_vec") "out_Mfile" else "out_file"
    file_suffix <- if (coef == "med_vec") ".M.tab.gz" else ".tab.gz"
    if (!is.null(dt_mi) && nrow(dt_mi) > 0L && all(c("iter", "med_gene_id", file_col) %in% names(dt_mi))) {
        idx <- dt_mi[iter == it & med_gene_id == mgid]
        if (nrow(idx) > 0L) {
            mf <- idx[[file_col]][1]
            if (!is.na(mf) && nzchar(mf) && file.exists(mf)) return(mf)
        }
    }
    mf <- file.path(pd$pth$out, sprintf("%03d_%s%s", it, file_label, file_suffix))
    if (file.exists(mf)) return(mf)
    stop("Mediation ", coef, " results file not found for mediator run label: ", file_label)
}

.cached_fread <- local({
    .cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
    function(path) {
        key <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
        if (exists(key, envir = .cache, inherits = FALSE)) {
            return(get(key, envir = .cache, inherits = FALSE))
        }
        dt <- data.table::fread(path)
        assign(key, dt, envir = .cache)
        dt
    }
})

build_mediator_impact_dt <- function(diag_dt, pd) {
    if (!data.table::is.data.table(diag_dt) || nrow(diag_dt) < 1L) {
        return(data.table::data.table(
            med_cl = character(0), mediator = character(0), outcome = character(0),
            fdr_base = numeric(0), logFC_base = numeric(0), t_base = numeric(0),
            fdr_apoe_med = numeric(0), logFC_apoe_med = numeric(0), t_apoe_med = numeric(0),
            fdr_med_vec = numeric(0), logFC_med_vec = numeric(0), t_med_vec = numeric(0)
        ))
    }

    min_or_na <- function(x) {
        x <- as.numeric(x)
        if (length(x) < 1L || all(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
        min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    first_present_col <- function(dt, candidates) {
        hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(dt)][1]
        if (is.na(hit) || !nzchar(hit)) return(NA_character_)
        hit
    }

    dt_br <- data.table::as.data.table(pd$dt$br)
    dt_md <- data.table::as.data.table(pd$dt$md)
    dt_mi <- pd$dt$mi
    gmap <- data.table::as.data.table(pd$key$gmap)

    if (!all(c("outcome_gene_id", "adj.P.Val") %in% names(dt_br))) {
        stop("Baseline table must contain outcome_gene_id and adj.P.Val.")
    }

    base_fc_col <- first_present_col(dt_br, c("logFC", "vlmf_logFC"))
    base_t_col <- first_present_col(dt_br, c("t", "vlmf_t"))
    base_map <- dt_br[
        !is.na(outcome_gene_id) & nzchar(as.character(outcome_gene_id)),
        {
            ii <- which(!is.na(adj.P.Val))
            best_i <- if (length(ii) > 0L) ii[which.min(adj.P.Val[ii])] else NA_integer_
            .(
                fdr = min_or_na(adj.P.Val),
                logFC = if (is.na(base_fc_col) || is.na(best_i)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(get(base_fc_col)[best_i]),
                t = if (is.na(base_t_col) || is.na(best_i)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(get(base_t_col)[best_i])
            )
        },
        by = .(outcome_gene_id = as.character(outcome_gene_id))
    ]

    impact_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(diag_dt)), function(i) {
        rr <- diag_dt[i]
        med_cl <- as.character(rr$cluster[[1]])
        mediator <- as.character(rr$mediator_gene[[1]])
        outcomes <- sort(unique(as.character(rr$outcome_genes[[1]])))
        if (length(outcomes) < 1L) return(NULL)

        out_ids <- as.character(gmap$gene_id[match(outcomes, as.character(gmap$gene_name))])

        apoe_med_map <- data.table::data.table(
            outcome_gene_id = character(0), fdr_apoe_med = numeric(0),
            logFC_apoe_med = numeric(0), t_apoe_med = numeric(0)
        )
        med_vec_map <- data.table::data.table(
            outcome_gene_id = character(0), fdr_med_vec = numeric(0),
            logFC_med_vec = numeric(0), t_med_vec = numeric(0)
        )
        med_key <- sprintf("%s:%s", med_cl, mediator)
        mr <- tryCatch(resolve_mediator_row(med_key, dt_md), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(mr)) {
            run_lb <- sprintf("%s|%s|%s", as.character(mr$cluster[[1]]), as.character(mr$gene_id[[1]]), as.character(mr$gene_name[[1]]))
            f_lb <- gsub("\\|", "_", run_lb)
            for (coef in c("carrier", "med_vec")) {
                mf <- tryCatch(
                    resolve_mediator_results_file(
                        pd = pd,
                        dt_mi = dt_mi,
                        it = as.integer(mr$iter[[1]]),
                        mgid = as.character(mr$med_gene_id[[1]]),
                        file_label = f_lb,
                        coef = coef
                    ),
                    error = function(e) NA_character_
                )
                if (!is.na(mf) && nzchar(mf) && file.exists(mf)) {
                    dt_mr <- .cached_fread(mf)
                    if (all(c("outcome_gene_id", "adj.P.Val") %in% names(dt_mr))) {
                        stat_fc_col <- first_present_col(dt_mr, c("logFC", "vlmf_logFC"))
                        stat_t_col <- first_present_col(dt_mr, c("t", "vlmf_t"))
                        stat_map <- dt_mr[
                            !is.na(outcome_gene_id) & nzchar(as.character(outcome_gene_id)),
                            {
                                ii <- which(!is.na(adj.P.Val))
                                best_i <- if (length(ii) > 0L) ii[which.min(adj.P.Val[ii])] else NA_integer_
                                .(
                                    fdr = min_or_na(adj.P.Val),
                                    logFC = if (is.na(stat_fc_col) || is.na(best_i)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(get(stat_fc_col)[best_i]),
                                    t = if (is.na(stat_t_col) || is.na(best_i)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(get(stat_t_col)[best_i])
                                )
                            },
                            by = .(outcome_gene_id = as.character(outcome_gene_id))
                        ]
                        if (coef == "med_vec") {
                            data.table::setnames(stat_map, c("fdr", "logFC", "t"), c("fdr_med_vec", "logFC_med_vec", "t_med_vec"))
                            med_vec_map <- stat_map
                        } else {
                            data.table::setnames(stat_map, c("fdr", "logFC", "t"), c("fdr_apoe_med", "logFC_apoe_med", "t_apoe_med"))
                            apoe_med_map <- stat_map
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        data.table::data.table(
            med_cl = med_cl,
            mediator = mediator,
            outcome = outcomes,
            fdr_base = as.numeric(base_map$fdr[match(out_ids, base_map$outcome_gene_id)]),
            logFC_base = as.numeric(base_map$logFC[match(out_ids, base_map$outcome_gene_id)]),
            t_base = as.numeric(base_map$t[match(out_ids, base_map$outcome_gene_id)]),
            fdr_apoe_med = as.numeric(apoe_med_map$fdr_apoe_med[match(out_ids, apoe_med_map$outcome_gene_id)]),
            logFC_apoe_med = as.numeric(apoe_med_map$logFC_apoe_med[match(out_ids, apoe_med_map$outcome_gene_id)]),
            t_apoe_med = as.numeric(apoe_med_map$t_apoe_med[match(out_ids, apoe_med_map$outcome_gene_id)]),
            fdr_med_vec = as.numeric(med_vec_map$fdr_med_vec[match(out_ids, med_vec_map$outcome_gene_id)]),
            logFC_med_vec = as.numeric(med_vec_map$logFC_med_vec[match(out_ids, med_vec_map$outcome_gene_id)]),
            t_med_vec = as.numeric(med_vec_map$t_med_vec[match(out_ids, med_vec_map$outcome_gene_id)])
        )
    })
    impact_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(impact_rows, fill = TRUE)
    data.table::setcolorder(impact_dt, c(
        "med_cl", "mediator", "outcome",
        "fdr_base", "logFC_base", "t_base",
        "fdr_apoe_med", "logFC_apoe_med", "t_apoe_med",
        "fdr_med_vec", "logFC_med_vec", "t_med_vec"
    ))
    if (nrow(impact_dt) > 0L) {
        data.table::setorderv(impact_dt, c("med_cl", "mediator", "outcome"), order = c(1L, 1L, 1L))
    }
    impact_dt
}

build_run_tables <- function(pd, source_dir, design, model, diag_info) {
    sig <- pd$meta$signature
    latest <- pd$meta$history_row
    sm <- data.table::copy(pd$dt$sm)

    n_mediators_screened <- as_int(sig$n_mediators_screened %||% sig$n_mediators %||% latest$n_mediators_screened %||% latest$n_mediators)
    n_mediators_eligible <- as_int(latest$n_mediators_eligible %||% unique(sm$n_mediators_eligible)[1])
    n_completed <- as_int(latest$n_completed %||% nrow(sm))
    n_validated_mediators <- as.integer(sum(as.logical(sm$pass_both), na.rm = TRUE))
    validated_genes_total <- as.integer(sum(as.integer(sm$mediated_n), na.rm = TRUE))

    run_overview <- data.table::data.table(
        design = design,
        model = model,
        source_dir = source_dir,
        out_dir = normalizePath(pd$pth$out, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE),
        mediation = as.character(sig$mediation %||% latest$mediation %||% NA_character_),
        run_hash = as.character(pd$pth$run_hash),
        latest_complete_run_hash = as.character(pd$meta$latest_complete_run_hash %||% pd$pth$run_hash),
        selected_hash_matches_latest_complete = identical(as.character(pd$pth$run_hash), as.character(pd$meta$latest_complete_run_hash %||% pd$pth$run_hash)),
        run_selection_mode = as.character(pd$meta$selection_mode),
        run_selection_warning = as.character(pd$meta$selection_warning %||% ""),
        run_started_at = as.character(latest$run_started_at %||% NA_character_),
        run_finished_at = as.character(latest$run_finished_at %||% NA_character_),
        FDRthr = as_num(sig$FDRthr %||% latest$FDRthr),
        medSelFDR = as_num(sig$medSelFDR %||% latest$medSelFDR),
        n_mediators_screened = n_mediators_screened,
        n_mediators_eligible = n_mediators_eligible,
        n_completed = n_completed,
        n_validated_mediators = n_validated_mediators,
        validated_genes_total = validated_genes_total,
        mediated_max = if (nrow(sm) > 0L) max(as.integer(sm$mediated_n), na.rm = TRUE) else 0L,
        n_unique_donor_sets = as_int(latest$n_unique_donor_sets),
        n_mediated_list_files_total = as.integer(diag_info$stats$total),
        n_mediated_list_files_used = as.integer(diag_info$stats$used),
        n_mediated_list_files_excluded_stale = as.integer(diag_info$stats$excluded_stale),
        outcome_donor_key = as.character(sig$outcome_donor_key %||% latest$outcome_donor_key %||% NA_character_),
        outcome_donor_str = as.character(sig$outcome_donor_str %||% latest$outcome_donor_str %||% NA_character_),
        baseline_formula = as.character(sig$baseline_formula %||% NA_character_),
        mediation_formula = as.character(sig$mediation_formula %||% NA_character_),
        drop_donors_global = as.character(sig$drop_donors_global %||% NA_character_),
        drop_donors_lc = as.character(sig$drop_donors_lc %||% NA_character_)
    )

    summary_metrics <- data.table::data.table(
        design = design,
        model = model,
        source_dir = source_dir,
        run_hash = as.character(pd$pth$run_hash),
        FDRthr = run_overview$FDRthr,
        medSelFDR = run_overview$medSelFDR,
        n_mediators_screened = n_mediators_screened,
        n_validated_mediators = n_validated_mediators,
        validated_genes_total = validated_genes_total,
        mediated_max = if (nrow(sm) > 0L) max(as.integer(sm$mediated_n), na.rm = TRUE) else 0L,
        baselineDEGs_unique = paste(sort(unique(as.integer(sm$baselineDEGs))), collapse = ","),
        outcomeDEGs_loss_total = sum(as.integer(sm$loss), na.rm = TRUE),
        outcomeDEGs_gain_total = sum(as.integer(sm$gain), na.rm = TRUE),
        n_donors_unique = paste(sort(unique(as.integer(sm$n_donors))), collapse = ",")
    )

    top <- data.table::copy(sm)
    data.table::setorderv(top, c("mediated_n", "mediation_run"), order = c(-1L, 1L))
    top <- top[mediated_n > 0]
    top <- top[seq_len(min(10L, .N))]
    if (nrow(top) > 0L) {
        top[, rank := seq_len(.N)]
        top[, `:=`(
            design = design,
            model = model,
            source_dir = source_dir,
            run_hash = as.character(pd$pth$run_hash),
            FDRthr = run_overview$FDRthr,
            medSelFDR = run_overview$medSelFDR,
            n_mediators_screened = n_mediators_screened,
            n_mediators_eligible = n_mediators_eligible,
            n_completed = n_completed
        )]
        top <- top[, .(
            design, model, source_dir, run_hash, rank, mediation_run, n_donors,
            FDRthr, medSelFDR, n_mediators_screened, n_mediators_eligible, n_completed,
            mediated_n, medSigBaselineDEGs, mediationCarrierDEGs, mediationMDEGs, pass_both
        )]
    } else {
        top <- data.table::data.table(
            design = character(0), model = character(0), source_dir = character(0),
            run_hash = character(0), rank = integer(0), mediation_run = character(0),
            n_donors = integer(0), FDRthr = numeric(0), medSelFDR = numeric(0),
            n_mediators_screened = integer(0), n_mediators_eligible = integer(0),
            n_completed = integer(0), mediated_n = integer(0), medSigBaselineDEGs = integer(0),
            mediationCarrierDEGs = integer(0), mediationMDEGs = integer(0), pass_both = logical(0)
        )
    }

    list(
        run_overview = run_overview,
        summary_metrics = summary_metrics,
        top_hits = top,
        common_meta = list(
            run_hash = as.character(pd$pth$run_hash),
            FDRthr = run_overview$FDRthr,
            medSelFDR = run_overview$medSelFDR,
            n_mediators_screened = n_mediators_screened,
            n_mediators_eligible = n_mediators_eligible,
            n_completed = n_completed
        )
    )
}

build_nonempty_mediated_lists_dt <- function(diag_used, source_dir, design, model, common_meta) {
    if (!data.table::is.data.table(diag_used) || nrow(diag_used) < 1L) {
        return(data.table::data.table(
            design = character(0), model = character(0), source_dir = character(0), run_hash = character(0),
            FDRthr = numeric(0), medSelFDR = numeric(0), n_mediators_screened = integer(0),
            n_mediators_eligible = integer(0), n_completed = integer(0), list_file = character(0),
            mediation_run = character(0), cluster = character(0), med_gene_id = character(0),
            mediator_gene = character(0), n_mediated = integer(0), list_path = character(0)
        ))
    }
    out <- data.table::copy(diag_used)
    out[, `:=`(
        design = design,
        model = model,
        source_dir = source_dir,
        run_hash = common_meta$run_hash,
        FDRthr = common_meta$FDRthr,
        medSelFDR = common_meta$medSelFDR,
        n_mediators_screened = common_meta$n_mediators_screened,
        n_mediators_eligible = common_meta$n_mediators_eligible,
        n_completed = common_meta$n_completed
    )]
    out[, .(
        design, model, source_dir, run_hash, FDRthr, medSelFDR,
        n_mediators_screened, n_mediators_eligible, n_completed,
        list_file, mediation_run, cluster, med_gene_id, mediator_gene, n_mediated, list_path
    )]
}

build_validated_by_mediator_dt <- function(sm, diag_used, source_dir, design, model, common_meta) {
    if (!data.table::is.data.table(sm) || nrow(sm) < 1L) {
        return(data.table::data.table(
            design = character(0), model = character(0), source_dir = character(0), run_hash = character(0),
            FDRthr = numeric(0), medSelFDR = numeric(0), n_mediators_screened = integer(0),
            n_mediators_eligible = integer(0), n_completed = integer(0), mediation_run = character(0),
            cluster = character(0), med_gene_id = character(0), mediator_gene = character(0),
            mediated_n = integer(0), n_donors = integer(0), list_file = character(0), list_path = character(0)
        ))
    }

    vv <- data.table::copy(sm[as.logical(pass_both) == TRUE & as.integer(mediated_n) > 0L])
    if (nrow(vv) < 1L) {
        return(data.table::data.table(
            design = character(0), model = character(0), source_dir = character(0), run_hash = character(0),
            FDRthr = numeric(0), medSelFDR = numeric(0), n_mediators_screened = integer(0),
            n_mediators_eligible = integer(0), n_completed = integer(0), mediation_run = character(0),
            cluster = character(0), med_gene_id = character(0), mediator_gene = character(0),
            mediated_n = integer(0), n_donors = integer(0), list_file = character(0), list_path = character(0)
        ))
    }

    run_parts <- strsplit(as.character(vv$mediation_run), "|", fixed = TRUE)
    vv[, cluster := vapply(run_parts, function(x) if (length(x) >= 1L) x[1] else NA_character_, character(1))]
    vv[, med_gene_id := vapply(run_parts, function(x) if (length(x) >= 2L) x[2] else NA_character_, character(1))]
    vv[, mediator_gene := vapply(run_parts, function(x) if (length(x) >= 3L) paste(x[3:length(x)], collapse = "|") else NA_character_, character(1))]

    list_map <- if (!is.null(diag_used) && nrow(diag_used) > 0L) {
        unique(diag_used[, .(mediation_run, list_file, list_path, n_mediated_list = n_mediated)])
    } else {
        data.table::data.table(mediation_run = character(0), list_file = character(0), list_path = character(0), n_mediated_list = integer(0))
    }

    vv <- merge(vv, list_map, by = "mediation_run", all.x = TRUE)
    vv[, `:=`(
        design = design,
        model = model,
        source_dir = source_dir,
        run_hash = common_meta$run_hash,
        FDRthr = common_meta$FDRthr,
        medSelFDR = common_meta$medSelFDR,
        n_mediators_screened = common_meta$n_mediators_screened,
        n_mediators_eligible = common_meta$n_mediators_eligible,
        n_completed = common_meta$n_completed
    )]

    data.table::setorderv(vv, c("mediated_n", "mediation_run"), order = c(-1L, 1L))
    vv[, .(
        design, model, source_dir, run_hash, FDRthr, medSelFDR,
        n_mediators_screened, n_mediators_eligible, n_completed,
        mediation_run, cluster, med_gene_id, mediator_gene,
        mediated_n, n_donors, list_file, list_path
    )]
}
```

```{r build-and-save}
run_overview_list <- list()
summary_metrics_list <- list()
top_hits_list <- list()
nonempty_lists_list <- list()
validated_by_mediator_list <- list()
impact_by_source <- list()
validation_by_source <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(main_designs))) {
    cfg <- main_designs[i]
    source_dir <- as.character(cfg$source_dir[[1]])
    design <- as.character(cfg$design[[1]])
    model <- as.character(cfg$model[[1]])
    out_dir <- file.path(code_med_dir, source_dir)

    pd <- loadMedDataSummary(out_dir)
    valid_run_labels <- unique(as.character(pd$dt$mi$run_label))
    diag_info <- build_mediated_diag(out_dir, valid_run_labels = valid_run_labels, small_first = FALSE)

    impact_dt <- build_mediator_impact_dt(diag_info$used, pd)
    if (nrow(impact_dt) > 0L) {
        impact_dt[, `:=`(design = design, model = model, source_dir = source_dir, run_hash = pd$pth$run_hash)]
    }
    impact_by_source[[source_dir]] <- impact_dt

    rt <- build_run_tables(pd, source_dir, design, model, diag_info)
    run_overview_list[[source_dir]] <- rt$run_overview
    summary_metrics_list[[source_dir]] <- rt$summary_metrics
    top_hits_list[[source_dir]] <- rt$top_hits

    nonempty_dt <- build_nonempty_mediated_lists_dt(
        diag_used = diag_info$used,
        source_dir = source_dir,
        design = design,
        model = model,
        common_meta = rt$common_meta
    )
    nonempty_lists_list[[source_dir]] <- nonempty_dt

    validated_dt <- build_validated_by_mediator_dt(
        sm = pd$dt$sm,
        diag_used = diag_info$used,
        source_dir = source_dir,
        design = design,
        model = model,
        common_meta = rt$common_meta
    )
    validated_by_mediator_list[[source_dir]] <- validated_dt

    validation_by_source[[source_dir]] <- data.table::data.table(
        source_dir = source_dir,
        runs_subset_ok = all(as.character(validated_dt$mediation_run) %in% valid_run_labels),
        mediated_count_match_ok = all(
            as.integer(validated_dt$mediated_n) == as.integer(pd$dt$sm$mediated_n[match(validated_dt$mediation_run, pd$dt$sm$mediation_run)])
        )
    )

    fwrite(rt$run_overview, file.path(out_data_dir, sprintf("mediation_run_report_%s.tsv", source_dir)), sep = "\t")
    fwrite(validated_dt, file.path(out_data_dir, sprintf("mediation_validated_by_mediator_%s.tsv", source_dir)), sep = "\t")
}

run_overview_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(run_overview_list, fill = TRUE)
summary_metrics_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(summary_metrics_list, fill = TRUE)
top_hits_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(top_hits_list, fill = TRUE)
nonempty_mediated_lists_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(nonempty_lists_list, fill = TRUE)
validated_by_mediator_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(validated_by_mediator_list, fill = TRUE)
validation_checks_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(validation_by_source, fill = TRUE)

orange_split <- summary_metrics_dt[source_dir %in% c("out-lc_nm", "out-lc_nm_int")]
if (nrow(orange_split) > 0L) {
    fdr_vals <- sort(unique(orange_split$FDRthr))
    medsel_vals <- sort(unique(orange_split$medSelFDR))
    orange_combined <- data.table::data.table(
        design = "orange",
        model = "NM_bin+NM_int",
        source_dir = "orange_combined",
        run_hash = paste(orange_split$run_hash, collapse = ";"),
        FDRthr = if (length(fdr_vals) == 1L) fdr_vals else NA_real_,
        medSelFDR = if (length(medsel_vals) == 1L) medsel_vals else NA_real_,
        n_mediators_screened = sum(as.integer(orange_split$n_mediators_screened), na.rm = TRUE),
        n_validated_mediators = sum(as.integer(orange_split$n_validated_mediators), na.rm = TRUE),
        validated_genes_total = sum(as.integer(orange_split$validated_genes_total), na.rm = TRUE),
        mediated_max = max(as.integer(orange_split$mediated_max), na.rm = TRUE),
        baselineDEGs_unique = paste(sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(paste(orange_split$baselineDEGs_unique, collapse = ","), ",", fixed = TRUE)))), collapse = ","),
        outcomeDEGs_loss_total = sum(as.integer(orange_split$outcomeDEGs_loss_total), na.rm = TRUE),
        outcomeDEGs_gain_total = sum(as.integer(orange_split$outcomeDEGs_gain_total), na.rm = TRUE),
        n_donors_unique = paste(sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(paste(orange_split$n_donors_unique, collapse = ","), ",", fixed = TRUE)))), collapse = ",")
    )
    summary_metrics_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(list(summary_metrics_dt, orange_combined), fill = TRUE)
}

impact_green <- impact_by_source[["out-erc_astro"]]
impact_blue <- impact_by_source[["out-lc_astro"]]
impact_orange <- data.table::rbindlist(
    list(impact_by_source[["out-lc_nm"]], impact_by_source[["out-lc_nm_int"]]),
    fill = TRUE
)

if (nrow(run_overview_dt) > 0) data.table::setorderv(run_overview_dt, c("design", "source_dir"), order = c(1L, 1L))
if (nrow(summary_metrics_dt) > 0) data.table::setorderv(summary_metrics_dt, c("design", "source_dir"), order = c(1L, 1L))
if (nrow(nonempty_mediated_lists_dt) > 0) data.table::setorderv(nonempty_mediated_lists_dt, c("design", "source_dir", "n_mediated", "list_file"), order = c(1L, 1L, -1L, 1L))
if (nrow(top_hits_dt) > 0) data.table::setorderv(top_hits_dt, c("design", "source_dir", "rank"), order = c(1L, 1L, 1L))
if (nrow(validated_by_mediator_dt) > 0) data.table::setorderv(validated_by_mediator_dt, c("design", "source_dir", "mediated_n", "mediation_run"), order = c(1L, 1L, -1L, 1L))
if (nrow(impact_green) > 0) data.table::setorderv(impact_green, c("design", "model", "source_dir", "med_cl", "mediator", "outcome"), order = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L))
if (nrow(impact_blue) > 0) data.table::setorderv(impact_blue, c("design", "model", "source_dir", "med_cl", "mediator", "outcome"), order = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L))
if (nrow(impact_orange) > 0) data.table::setorderv(impact_orange, c("design", "model", "source_dir", "med_cl", "mediator", "outcome"), order = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L))

fwrite(run_overview_dt, file.path(out_data_dir, "mediation_run_overview_main.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(summary_metrics_dt, file.path(out_data_dir, "mediation_summary_metrics_main.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(nonempty_mediated_lists_dt, file.path(out_data_dir, "mediation_nonempty_mediated_lists_main.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(top_hits_dt, file.path(out_data_dir, "mediation_top_hits_main.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(validated_by_mediator_dt, file.path(out_data_dir, "mediation_validated_by_mediator_main.tsv"), sep = "\t")

fwrite(impact_green, file.path(out_data_dir, "mediator_outcome_fdr_impact_green.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(impact_blue, file.path(out_data_dir, "mediator_outcome_fdr_impact_blue.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(impact_orange, file.path(out_data_dir, "mediator_outcome_fdr_impact_orange.tsv"), sep = "\t")

cat(sprintf("Saved run overview rows: %d\n", nrow(run_overview_dt)))
cat(sprintf("Saved summary metrics rows: %d\n", nrow(summary_metrics_dt)))
cat(sprintf("Saved non-empty mediated list rows: %d\n", nrow(nonempty_mediated_lists_dt)))
cat(sprintf("Saved top hits rows: %d\n", nrow(top_hits_dt)))
cat(sprintf("Saved validated-by-mediator rows: %d\n", nrow(validated_by_mediator_dt)))
cat(sprintf("Saved impact rows: green=%d blue=%d orange=%d\n", nrow(impact_green), nrow(impact_blue), nrow(impact_orange)))
```
